Subject: Renewal discussion + early renewal incentive

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re well — my name is Jordan (your Salesloft account rep). Your current agreement is up in late July, and we wanted to open the conversation early so we can lock in pricing and avoid last-minute interruptions. We can offer a 12% early-renewal credit if the PO is in by July 15.

Quick summary of what’s changed since your last term: improved sequence analytics, new Conversations API rate tiers, and an optional migration service to migrate legacy sequences. Attached is a draft SOW that outlines scope and pricing for the migration add-on.

Two quick questions for your team so we can finalize the SOW:
- Does Redwood require full export of sequences + cadences in CSV/JSON?
- Any specific SSO/Kerberos requirements or security attestations beyond SAML2?

If useful I can put Meera (contracts) on the thread to start the paperwork.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call.

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and the draft. A few things from our side before we loop in legal: 

1) Data export: yes, we need a reproducible export of all sequences, steps, template content, cadence membership and scheduling rules in both CSV and JSON. We’ll also need the mapping for any proprietary fields. Please attach a sample export (columns + example rows).

2) APIs & rate limits: we use the Conversations API for live syncs; can you confirm sustained rate limits and burst behaviour? Also need SLA language for API availability (we target 99.9% for core syncs).

3) SSO: SAML2 is our standard; we also require IdP-initiated flows to be supported and SCIM for user provisioning.

Looping in Grace to scope the migration effort and to estimate seat mapping. I’m going to put this on paper as an internal decision path (renew vs migrate to alternative) — quick meeting tomorrow morning?

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Team — thanks for collating. From legal’s perspective: 

1) Add API availability SLA to main contract (99.9%) and include an SLA credit table. Keep the measurement and remedy clear (monthly uptime measured at endpoint level).
2) Export deliverable must include data dictionary, sample exports, and a signed acceptance criteria for the delivered export. Add 30-day remediation window for any missing fields.
3) Vendor data retention: require deletion certificate within 30 days of contract termination and right to audit exports for 12 months.
4) Limit vendor liability tied to migration work to the SOW value only; do not accept broad unlimited indemnities.

Jordan / Meera — please incorporate the above in the redline and return to Laura.Bennett@redwood.ai. Grace / Rishi — once we have the updated SOW + Blue Mangrove estimate we can finalize decision. If the numbers line up, we’ll target PO + DocuSign by July 12 to capture the early-renewal credit.

—Laura
